Governmental spending is printed only by object (no function); statement lines take the function of the dominant fund (review). Business-type (Water, Sewer) from the proprietary statement Total column (p10); disbursements total = Statement of Activities business-type cash disbursements 162,245.10 (p2). Balance sheet: governmental lines from the governmental funds statement (p9, totals equal the government-wide figures), business-type from the Statement of Net Position (p1); component unit excluded. Detail: General, Street and TIF funds from the combined budget and actual schedules (pp11-12; trimmed pages are report pp28 and 30 only, the continuation pages with the Bond Fund and the receipts budget column are not in the trim, so the Bond Fund has no detail lines; budgeted disbursements are printed only as fund totals: General 224,000, Street 491,000, TIF 12,700). Utility detail from the proprietary budget and actual schedule (p13; budget column covers both funds combined, so budget_final left null: Use Fees 210,000, Operating Disbursements 165,000, Capital Outlay 290,000, Grants, Bonds & Loans 47,500).
